user.description: Choose the STRx device to set up.

bluetooth_confirm.description:
Set up {name}?

Broadcast mode: **{mode}**. The tank level is only broadcast while Broadcast Mode is on in the Simarine Connect app, under Device Management → Broadcast Settings.

get_encryption_key.title: Encryption key
get_encryption_key.description:
{name} encrypts its broadcast. In the Simarine Connect app open Device Management → Broadcast Settings → Show Encryption Key and enter the 32 hexadecimal digits shown there.

Regenerate Encryption Key and a factory reset replace the key, it then has to be entered again here.

reconfigure.title: Encryption key
reconfigure.description:
Change the encryption key of {name}.

Leave it empty if the device broadcasts in Open mode on purpose. While a key is set, an unencrypted broadcast is rejected.

error.no_scan_response: No scan response received from the device. Make sure it is in range, that no other host is connected to it, and that a Bluetooth adapter or proxy can scan actively.
error.invalid_key_format: The key must be 32 hexadecimal digits.
error.decryption_failed: The key does not decrypt the broadcast. Check that it is the current key shown in the app.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found: No STRx devices found in range
abort.unsupported_protocol: The device uses a protocol version this integration does not support. Update the integration.

encryption_downgrade.title: {name} stopped encrypting its broadcast
encryption_downgrade.description:
{name} has an encryption key but now broadcasts its level unencrypted (Open). The level is ignored, since an unencrypted broadcast can be forged.

If you switched the device to Open on purpose, reconfigure it and clear the encryption key. Otherwise choose a Security mode again in the Simarine Connect app.

unsupported_protocol.title: {name} uses an unsupported protocol
unsupported_protocol.description: {name} broadcasts a protocol major version this integration does not support. Update the Simarine STRx integration.
